verdict: C3 NON-INFERIOR by prereg margin on point estimate (-0.067 inside 1/6), McNemar p=0.625 (no significant difference), at ~62% fewer memory tokens (~820 -> ~310/turn). 95% CI lower bound (-0.195) just past margin: ship/no-ship is conductor's call; evidence supports C3 as the cap value, C1/C0 excluded by n=6 (0/6, 1/6).
